# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `dead-brands-llc` MCP server pointing at the submitted Dead Brands URL (`https://mcp.deadbrands.co`).
- No API key or account required, per the publisher.
- Logo: references the publisher's `https://deadbrands.co/apple-touch-icon.png`; no local image is committed because the file could not be downloaded.
